title.en: What does PMI and PMP mean?

description.en:
PMI (Project Management Institute): The world's leading association for project management professionals that sets global standards.

PMP (Project Management Professional): The most important international certification in project management, issued by PMI to experts who meet strict experience and exam requirements.
description.ar:
PMI (معهد إدارة المشاريع): الجهة العالمية الرائدة التي تضع معايير إدارة المشاريع.

PMP (محترف إدارة المشاريع): أهم شهادة دولية في إدارة المشاريع، يمنحها PMI للخبراء الذين يستوفون متطلبات الخبرة والاختبار.

title.en: What makes your PMP exam simulator unique compared to other platforms?
title.ar: ما الذي يميز محاكي PMP لديكم؟

description.en: Our simulator is designed to be the closest experience to the actual exam. It goes beyond simple practice tests by offering a dynamic bank of 1,620 questions aligned with the latest PMP exam format, realistic timed exam simulations, and in-depth explanations grounded in the PMBOK® Guide 7th Edition and Agile principles. We ensure you're prepared not just to recall information, but to apply it effectively in real-world scenarios.

title.en: What do I need to apply for the official PMI - PMP exam?

description.en:
You need to meet these 2 main requirements:

1. 35 Contact Hours of Project Management Training: You will receive this certificate upon completion of our course.

2. Education & Experience:
- If you have a 4-year university degree: You need 3 years (36 months) of project experience.
- If you have a high school diploma or associate degree: You need 5 years (60 months) of project experience.

Note: You are not required to hold the title of 'Project Manager.' What matters is that you have worked in a project-based environment. Personal and private projects may also be considered as qualifying experience.
